commands.title: Current kubectl context
commands.description: Show the cluster and identity context targeted by subsequent kubectl commands.

commands.title: Cluster endpoints
commands.description: Show control-plane and core service endpoints for the current context.

commands.title: Nodes with addressing
commands.description: Show node readiness, roles, versions, addresses, images, and container runtime.

commands.title: Node details
commands.description: Show one node's conditions, capacity, allocations, labels, taints, pods, and events.

commands.title: Pods in all namespaces
commands.description: Show pod readiness, state, restarts, addresses, nodes, and namespaces.

commands.title: Pod details
commands.description: Show container state, probes, mounts, scheduling, conditions, and events for one pod.

commands.title: Bounded pod logs
commands.description: Read a bounded timestamped log tail; application output can contain secrets.

commands.title: Previous container logs
commands.description: Read bounded logs from the previous terminated container instance.

commands.title: Cluster events by time
commands.description: Show scheduling, health, image, volume, and policy events across namespaces.

commands.title: Node resource usage
commands.description: Show current node CPU and memory usage when Metrics Server is available.

commands.title: Pod resource usage
commands.description: Show current pod CPU and memory use across namespaces, sorted by CPU.

commands.title: Deployments in all namespaces
commands.description: Show desired, current, available, and updated replicas and container images.

commands.title: Deployment rollout status
commands.description: Watch one deployment until its rollout completes or fails.

commands.title: Services in all namespaces
commands.description: Show service types, cluster and external addresses, selectors, and ports.

commands.title: Endpoint slices
commands.description: Show service backend endpoint slices and address types across namespaces.

commands.title: Ingress resources
commands.description: Show ingress classes, hosts, addresses, ports, and age.

commands.title: Persistent volumes and claims
commands.description: Show persistent volume capacity, access, class, binding, status, and claims.

commands.title: Check current authorization
commands.description: Ask the API authorization layer whether the current identity can perform one action.

commands.title: Restart deployment rollout
commands.description: Trigger replacement of all pods in one deployment and potentially disrupt workload capacity.

commands.title: Delete one pod
commands.description: Delete one pod; a controller may replace it, but active connections and local state can be lost.
